    participant Client as AI Client (Cursor/Claude)

    Note over Bridge: Executes on Unity Main Thread

    Tool-->>Bridge: return SuccessResponse
    Bridge-->>Hub: JSON-RPC Response
    Hub-->>Server: Forward Result
    Server-->>Client: MCP Result: Success
